name: EPIC 212361503

text.card: A red giant 3,038 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.85 solar masses and 10.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,909 K at its surface.
